configuration.direction: LTR except fixtures with explicit layoutDirection
configuration.alignItems: explicit containerStyle when present; otherwise flex-start
configuration.alignContent: explicit containerStyle when present; otherwise flex-start
configuration.gap: explicit numeric or allocated-axis percentage per case; nested owners use10%
configuration.shrink: explicit itemStyles when present; nested outer items1 and inner leaves0; otherwise1 except floor/border cases0
configuration.comparison: native boxes match except explicitly classified partial-factor/freeze, CSS safe-overflow reverse and preserved physical-margin cases; pibblBoxes are expected Pibbl contract geometry
configuration.padding: explicit numeric/percentage item or container padding per case; asymmetric physical3/5/7/11 in border cases; otherwise0
configuration.boxSizing: explicit item/container boxSizing per case; rectangle-percent-content-box uses content-box; otherwise Yoga default
configuration.border: physical left2/right4/top6/bottom8 in asymmetric border cases; otherwise 0
